content:
Rumors have long suggested that Apple has been working on a major overhaul of its Home lineup for years, and a new leak has provided a list of products worth looking forward to.

macOS code leak mentions several unreleased Home devices

Apple's biggest annual launch event is just weeks away, where multiple new Home products are expected to be unveiled alongside the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone Ultra, new Apple Watch models, and more.

Rumors point to a brand-new Apple TV 4K, HomePod mini 2, and the long-awaited HomePad. But there are several other Home products that may also debut soon.

MacRumors discovered yesterday that the newly released macOS 26.7 RC version contains information related to several unreleased products.

Among them are codenames related to Home devices. According to Juli Clover:

  • HomePad (J490 and J491): "J490 is reportedly the version with a dock designed as a home hub, while J491 is designed for wall mounting."
  • HomePod mini 2 (B525): The HomePod mini's codename is B520, so this is very likely the mini 2.
  • Home Accessory (J229): Most likely the rumored security camera product.
  • HomeAccessory17,2 and HomeAccessory17,3: Newly mentioned unknown Home devices.
  • ATVRemote1,5: A new generation Siri Remote, expected to launch alongside the new Apple TV 4K.

Other rumored Home products in development also include a video doorbell and a desktop robotic home hub. It is currently unclear whether their codenames have appeared in the macOS 26.7 leak.

Apart from the products, MacRumors also discovered the word "Pebble", believed to be the codename for homeOS. There is also a string "audio_accessory_visual_reasoning", which may be related to the HomePad.

Finally, four colors were also found in the data for an unspecified Home accessory: Rose Pink, Silver, Space Gray, and Starlight.

Best Apple Home accessories recommendations

  • eufy 4K camera (supports HomeKit Secure Video)
  • Aqara smart lock (supports Apple Home Key and UWB)
  • HomeKit garage door opener
  • HomeKit smart plug (four-pack)
  • Aqara smart thermostat (supports adaptive temperature)
